t: This Titan multi-tool accessory kit provides 116 pieces for cutting, sanding, scraping, polishing, grouting and grinding across a wide variety of materials. It is an essential addition for tradespeople undertaking diverse projects, from fitting kitchens and bathrooms to general renovation work. The set includes durable CrV Japanese teeth oscillating tool blades, engineered with sharper teeth for enhanced wood-cutting performance. Delta and finger sanding sheets feature 5 grit levels, pre-punched holes and hook and loop backing for effective dust removal and quick sheet changes. This accessory kit is compatible with most quick-change and non-quick-change systems, including DeWalt, Makita, Erbauer, Titan, Ryobi and Milwaukee.
